FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Does it cost anything to start?–

No. No fee, no investment.

When do I get paid?+

After the card is approved and activated. The exact timeline is on each card's page in the GroMo app.

Is approval certain?+

No. Approval is the bank's decision, after a credit assessment. Never promise a customer approval.

Where do I track my leads?+

In the GroMo app, under Credit Card - every lead with its live status.

Pick a card. Share the link.

Every lead shows up in the app with its live status, and the payout lands on approval.
